title: Which platforms share the inferred project records and the requests of the graph exchange
description: A project's inferred record is a function of the project's files plus one platform parameter that only a few projects read: `process.platform` in project assembly, only for a target that declares `metadata.semio.hostPlatformOutputsV1` (one project of the repository, the plugin descriptor emitter). Measured on the production cache (2870 records, 2026-11-14): of 498 projects recorded on darwin-arm64 and on linux-x64, 496 have byte-identical records once the closure handles (hashes of the producer's absolute root) are mapped to the hash of their recipe; the other 2 differ by one entry of a shared source list (a tree difference, not the platform); of 256 projects recorded on darwin-arm64 and win32-x64, 252 differ (root spelling and quoted commands). So the POSIX hosts form one class, Windows stays alone, and a record whose key text names a host-bound declaration is keyed by the exact platform. A request of the graph exchange is served by every machine of the requester's class.
